claims.statement: Element geometry APIs such as getBoundingClientRect() and offsetWidth require an active layout box generated by CSS box generation and layout.

proof.quote: Element geometry APIs such as getBoundingClientRect() and offsetWidth require an active layout box generated by CSS box generation and layout.

claims.statement: jsdom does not have the capability to render visual content, and will return zeros for layout-dependent properties like offsetTop and getBoundingClientRect().
